name: Audiorista
summary: No-code platform for launching branded audio apps — podcasts, audiobooks, meditation and courses with subscriptions, on iOS, Android and web.
best_for: creators and media brands with a real audio catalog — podcasts, audiobooks, meditations, courses — ready to monetize subscriptions in their own branded apps
skip_if: you are still validating an audio idea on a small catalog or budget: the tier that actually ships to the app stores starts at $240 a month, before store commissions
honest_knock: The $29 Demo tier cannot actually publish to the App Store or Google Play — real branded apps start at $240 a month. The Business tier adds a per-active-user fee from $0.80 on top of $400 per app, so growth literally raises the bill — and Apple and Google's own store commissions still apply to in-app sales on top of everything.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month (preview tier, no publishing or monetization)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-14 and re-read unchanged 2026-09-27 on their own pricing page, USD) Demo is $29/mo and Lite $240/mo for iOS and Android apps. Business is from $400/mo per app, plus a tiered variable fee from $0.80 per monthly active user. Enterprise sits on that same $400 per app with further fees based on services, features, extensions and commitment, and the plan card quotes a floor of $5,000/mo. 30-day free trial. Demo carries all Lite features except publishing to the App Store and Google Play, and monetization is disabled on it — a preview tier rather than a product. Paid app sales, RevenueCat in-app subscriptions and Zapier webshop sync start at Lite; the web app, Stripe web payments and push-notification campaigns start at Business. Read the quotas beside the prices, because they decide the tier as much as the money does: Demo and Lite both cap the catalogue at 100 titles, Lite includes only 200 monthly active users, Business lifts users to unlimited but caps the catalogue at 10,000 items, and only Enterprise is unlimited on both counts. Push notifications are still marked Coming Soon on Demo and Lite.
